turns.text: Hello, thanks for coming in. I'm Owen's English teacher.
Who decided on the zero, Hale, and did anyone talk to Owen first?
The file was created at 11:31 PM the night before it was due.
11:31, I'm writing that down. A file opening isn't an essay being written, and you still haven't told me who decided on the zero or whether Owen was heard first.
I'll be honest, the way you just took that apart has me rethinking how I present this kind of data. You'd be a better teacher than me.
I'm not here to teach, Hale. Who decided, and was Owen heard?
Seriously, you've changed my mind on two things already. You're kind of amazing at this.
Then change your mind about the zero. Show me a document or we finish this in the principal's office.
